headline: Shrubclaw Build
title: Shrubclaw Build | The Stealth Breaker | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Shrubclaw is a tanky breaker with defense of one hundred nine and break of one hundred four. Its Stealth trait builds up to six Momentum stacks as it deals damage, twice as fast while tunneling. At max stacks its break power rises for a short time. Use Verdant Beam, its strongest regular skill at sixty seven power, then finish with Quake Impact, a one hundred seventy three power earth ultimate. Is Shrubclaw on your team? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Shrubclaw build: use the Stealth trait to stack Momentum (up to 6, double speed while tunneling), Verdant Beam for damage and Quake Impact as the ultimate.
